claim.value: Delivery failure can produce no detectable effect even when the mechanism being addressed matters.
claim.scope: A possible implementation limitation, not a report that delivery failed.

provenance.rationale: P034 explicitly states this possibility and preserves the distinction between intervention results and mechanism relevance.

signal_basis.value: The release test measures differences in first-publication rates; no detectable effect can occur with delivery failure.
signal_basis.scope: A possible outcome of the release test, without asserting that delivery failure occurred or caused any observed result.

provenance.rationale: P022 identifies the measured signal, and P034 supplies the possible delivery limitation and absence of a detectable effect.
The bounded possibility claim is supported without an unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: Failure to deliver a change can prevent it from affecting the relevant mechanism. Consequently, no detectable intervention effect is compatible with that mechanism mattering. This licenses the stated possibility, without identifying the cause of a particular null result.
uncertainty: The packet does not establish whether delivery failed or whether the addressed mechanism matters in any actual test; neither is asserted by this claim.
